purpose.headline: Profile inference workloads before quoting GPU capacity
purpose.subhead: The same discovery questions we'd ask before a dedicated inference deal — input shape, cache behavior, concurrency, and latency — backed by live benches on hardware, model, and serving layers — all on Modal (CUDA, NCCL, vLLM).
purpose.audience: Solutions architects · AI-native inference on owned GPU capacity

questions.question: Typical input length (tokens)?
questions.why: Drives KV memory and prefill (TTFT). Grows ~linearly with context.

questions.question: Typical output length (tokens)?
questions.why: Decode time and batch slot occupancy under continuous batching.

questions.question: How often is the prompt prefix reused?
questions.why: High cache hit → warm prefix TTFT; low hit → size for cold prefill.

questions.question: Peak concurrent requests?
questions.why: Sets batch depth, queue delay, and GPU count for serving SLOs.

questions.question: TTFT / end-to-end latency SLO?
questions.why: Separates model-layer prefill from HTTP + queue overhead in serving.

scenarios.title: AI-native app · repeated system prompt
scenarios.subtitle: Cursor-style: same instructions every request, many users

discoveries.label: Cold TTFT (first request)
discoveries.detail: No prefix cached — full prefill cost.

discoveries.label: Prefix cache win
discoveries.detail: Same workload shape — cache hit is the biggest TTFT lever.

scenarios.recommendation: Size for warm-prefix TTFT and peak concurrency, not first-request cold prefill. Enable prefix caching in vLLM; expect a material TTFT drop once prompts stabilize.

scenarios.title: Batch document processing · cold prefix
scenarios.subtitle: Fixed PDF shape, 2s latency target, low cache reuse

discoveries.label: Model-layer TTFT (prefill)
discoveries.detail: Batch=1, no HTTP — pure prefill at S=4096.

discoveries.label: KV cache (GQA)
discoveries.detail: Memory floor for this context length on one replica.

discoveries.label: GQA vs dense KV
discoveries.detail: Qwen2.5-7B with n_kv=4 — planning with dense math over-provisions VRAM.

discoveries.label: Serving TTFT (cold, vLLM)
discoveries.detail: Adds engine + batching overhead on top of model prefill.

scenarios.recommendation: Profile model-layer TTFT first (prefill bound). If SLO is tight, add GPUs / tensor parallel before tuning batch size. Do not quote from API TTFT alone.

scenarios.title: Capacity planning · before you quote tokens
scenarios.subtitle: Hardware floor for multi-GPU and memory-bound decode

discoveries.label: BF16 GEMM
discoveries.detail: Prefill / large matmul throughput on same SKU.

scenarios.recommendation: Use hardware memcpy + NCCL to sanity-check TP configs. Pair with model-layer KV GiB before committing dedicated GPU contracts.
